verdict.rationale: The evidence documents an official Proton Pass CLI for scripts and CI/CD pipelines, plus open-source client repositories. It shows no official SDK or programmatic library for developers to build against. A CLI and open-source client code are adjacent building blocks, not an SDK, so the story is unevidenced even though SDKs are a fair axis for a password manager.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
